decisions.pe: A teenager from Togo was made to work in a home in Paris for years without pay or rest. The European Court said France broke the Convention because its criminal law did not properly punish servitude. France changed its law.
decisions.pi: Seorang remaja dari Togo dipaksa bekerja di sebuah rumah di Paris bertahun-tahun tanpa upah dan istirahat. Pengadilan HAM Eropa menyatakan Prancis melanggar Konvensi karena hukum pidananya tidak cukup menghukum perhambaan. Prancis mengubah undang-undangnya.

decisions.pe: A man from Côte d’Ivoire with a disability, living lawfully in France, was refused an allowance because he was not French or from a treaty country. The Court found discrimination.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria penyandang disabilitas dari Pantai Gading yang tinggal sah di Prancis ditolak tunjangan karena bukan warga Prancis atau negara mitra perjanjian. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.

decisions.pe: A family from Kazakhstan, with a baby and a three-year-old, was held for two weeks in an immigration detention centre. The Court said this harmed the children and broke the Convention.
decisions.pi: Sebuah keluarga dari Kazakhstan, dengan bayi dan anak tiga tahun, ditahan dua minggu di pusat detensi imigrasi. Mahkamah menyatakan ini merugikan anak dan melanggar Konvensi.

decisions.pe: A Spanish national lawfully living in France was kept for some fourteen years on short temporary residence receipts. The Court found that the prolonged insecurity of her status breached her right to private and family life (Art. 8). Comparator on precarious residence.
decisions.pi: Seorang warga Spanyol yang tinggal secara sah di Prancis selama sekitar empat belas tahun hanya diberi tanda terima izin tinggal sementara berjangka pendek. Mahkamah menilai ketidakpastian status yang berkepanjangan itu melanggar hak atas kehidupan pribadi dan keluarga (Pasal 8). Pembanding.

decisions.pe: An unaccompanied Afghan child lived for months in the Calais camp without the protective care ordered by a French judge. The Court found degrading treatment (Art. 3) because the authorities failed to provide care. Comparator on unaccompanied migrant children.
decisions.pi: Seorang anak Afghanistan tanpa pendamping tinggal berbulan-bulan di kamp Calais tanpa pengasuhan yang diperintahkan hakim Prancis. Mahkamah menyatakan terjadi perlakuan merendahkan martabat (Pasal 3) karena otoritas gagal memberikan pengasuhan. Pembanding.

help.city: Paris, dengan layanan hukum di seluruh Prancis
help.de: Free legal help desks (permanences) for foreigners on residence permits, detention and dealing with the authorities. Find the desk for your area on its website.
help.di: Layanan hukum gratis (permanences) bagi warga asing tentang izin tinggal, penahanan dan urusan dengan pemerintah. Cari layanan di daerah Anda di situsnya.

help.de: Legal advice by telephone for foreigners, and free legal guides to download. Has long handled work accidents, dismissal and papers.
help.di: Nasihat hukum lewat telepon bagi warga asing, dan panduan hukum gratis untuk diunduh. Lama menangani kecelakaan kerja, pemecatan dan dokumen.
